title: Senior Application Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle NetSuite builds cloud business applications that help organizations manage financials, operations, commerce, and more.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Application Software Engineer who combines strong technical fundamentals with curiosity about better ways to build software. You’ll design and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for enterprise customers, collaborate across engineering, product management, and help improve how the team develops and operates software.
  
  
This is a hands-on role with ownership from understanding the business problem through design, implementation, testing, release, and production support. We value engineers who use AI-assisted development thoughtfully while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of their work
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical designs, identifying dependencies, edge cases, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Own the delivery of features and improvements across design, coding, testing, release, and production support.
* Develop and maintain services, APIs, database-backed applications, and user-facing capabilities with attention to reliability, security, performance, and scalability.
* Investigate complex issues, understand unfamiliar code, and improve existing systems through practical, incremental changes.
* Use approved AI-assisted tools to support code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. Independently validate generated output and remain accountable for its correctness and quality.
* Build quality into development through automated tests, code reviews, and validation of data integrity, backward compatibility, and performance.
* Collaborate with product management, UX, QA, and other engineering teams to clarify scope, resolve dependencies, and deliver useful customer outcomes.
* Contribute to technical decisions, explain tradeoffs, and identify opportunities to simplify architecture and reduce technical debt.
* Mentor engineers through constructive feedback, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.
* Improve development workflows through automation and AI, assessing benefits through delivery effectiveness, quality, and maintainability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including independently delivering features or substantial system improvements.
* Strong proficiency in Java or a comparable object-oriented programming language, such as C# or Python.
* Solid understanding of software design, data structures, algorithms, and debugging.
* Strong SQL and relational database skills, including data modeling, transactions, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Experience developing web applications or services, with an understanding of how browser, service, API, and database layers interact.
* Ability to design maintainable solutions and evaluate tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, complexity, and delivery effort.
* Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and continuous integration.
* Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively, or learn them quickly, while critically reviewing their output and following security and data-handling requirements.
* Clear communication skills and experience collaborating across functions and mentoring engineers.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP, financial, or other enterprise business applications.
* Familiarity with NetSuite and SuiteScript.
* Experience building or supporting distributed systems and diagnosing production performance or reliability issues.
* Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or modern frontend development.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications using model APIs, retrieval, or tool integrations, including evaluating output quality and handling failures.
* Examples of improving engineering productivity or software quality through automation and AI-assisted workflows.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

About Us

Mercari is Japan's biggest C2C marketplace founded in 2013 with the mission to “create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell”.

From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S.

We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Backend Software Engineer**
with experience building and scaling products at internet product companies. You will own backend services, APIs and microservices end to end, contributing to a new healthcare technology platform that supports patient journeys, clinical workflows and hospital operations.

This is a high-ownership role for engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, making architectural decisions, and building reliable, secure and scalable systems. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams and mentor junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop and operate scalable backend services, APIs and microservices using Java or Python.
* Own features end to end, from architecture and development to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Design efficient data models, API contracts, caching strategies and asynchronous, event-driven workflows.
* Build reliable, secure and high-performance systems with strong automated testing and production monitoring.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, Redis, and messaging systems such as Kafka.
* Write design documents, evaluate architectural trade-offs and contribute to technical decision-making.
* Follow security and data privacy best practices, including access controls, encryption and audit trails.
* Participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues and contribute to on-call support.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to improve development productivity while maintaining code quality and security.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers and clinical and operations teams to translate real-world requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor Associate Software Engineers and help establish strong engineering practices.

Must-Have Skills

* **Experience:**
  3–4 years of backend development, including at least 3 years in internet product companies such as consumer internet, e-commerce, fintech or marketplaces.
* **Programming:**
  Strong proficiency in Java or Python, with hands-on experience in Spring Boot or FastAPI.
* **Product Ownership:**
  Experience taking a product feature or service through design, development, launch and production operations.
* **System Design:**
  Understanding of scalability, availability, consistency, reliability and architectural trade-offs.
* **Low-Level Design:**
  Strong fundamentals in object-oriented programming, design patterns, class design and API contracts.
* **Databases & Caching:**
  Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL or MongoDB, along with Redis.
* **Messaging:**
  Experience with Kafka or similar messaging and streaming technologies.
* **AI-Assisted Development:**
  Practical experience using AI coding tools or agents for planning, coding, testing, debugging and refactoring, with the ability to validate their output.
* **Problem Solving:**
  Strong data structures, algorithms and analytical thinking.
* **Ownership & Communication:**
  Ability to work independently, handle ambiguity, communicate technical decisions and collaborate with senior stakeholders.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and Git-based workflows.
* Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms and hybrid cloud/on-premise environments.
* Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into production applications.
* Experience building engineering automations or agents using MCP or similar tool integrations.
* Experience integrating third-party systems, payment gateways, ERPs or messaging platforms.
* Exposure to healthcare, fintech or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7/FHIR or ABDM.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers.
* Exposure to frontend technologies such as React.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

* Build core healthcare technology platforms from the ground up.
* Work on high-impact systems supporting patients, doctors, nurses and hospital operations.
* Take end-to-end ownership in a small, fast-moving engineering team.
* Work on AI-first experiences, healthcare data platforms and modern distributed systems.
* Influence engineering standards, architecture and AI-assisted development practices.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A product-focused backend engineer who has shipped production systems at scale, demonstrates strong system design and coding fundamentals, actively uses AI-assisted development tools, and is excited to build reliable technology that improves healthcare delivery.

* Diagnose and fix defects, including reproducing issues and working through unfamiliar parts of the code base.

* Microsoft Teams app development and integration with Power Apps
* C# / .NET plugin development against Dataverse

Your job is to turn frontier model capability into reliable production behavior: agents that read complex medical records, use the right clinical and coding context, call the right tools, produce auditable outputs, and improve real-world failures.

You will be embedded in hard healthcare problems, clinical documentation integrity, medical coding, denial prevention, appeals, revenue cycle workflows, and payer logic — and will own the loop from problem framing to agent design, evaluation, deployment, trace analysis, and ongoing improvement.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who thinks like an applied scientist: rigorous about measurement, comfortable with ambiguity, excited by messy real-world data, and motivated by closing the gap between impressive demos and dependable production systems.

Most AI roles are either too research-heavy or too product-light. This role sits in the middle. You will not only write prompts or run experiments. * Design, build, and continuously improve production AI systems for complex healthcare workflows, including documentation, coding, denial management, appeals, and revenue cycle automation.

title: Senior Engineer,  Site Reliability Engineering
description:
**Role Summary**
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you’ll provide deep reliability and operational expertise for business-critical cloud services. You’ll help set the reliability strategy (for example, defining SLOs and error budgets), design the observability and automation that keep services balanced, and lead improvements that reduce operational risk and customer impact. This role suits people who enjoy solving complex production problems and raising the standard for engineering excellence—regardless of whether your background is SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering with strong operations experience.
  
  
On-call: You’ll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. As a senior specialist, you’ll help improve how we run on-call by reducing noisy alerts, automating repetitive tasks, and strengthening operational readiness so incidents become less frequent and easier to resolve. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly and continuously improve the on-call experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own reliability outcomes for critical user journeys and cloud components by defining SLIs/SLOs, setting error budgets, and using data to prioritise resilience work.
* Design observability standards (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting) using tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly.
* Lead major incident response as incident commander when needed, drive blameless post-incident reviews, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and measured.
* Improve platform resilience and scalability through reliability architecture reviews, capacity and performance engineering, and proactive risk assessments.
* Reduce toil by automating repetitive operational work (for example with Terraform, CI/CD, and scripting), and track improvements through clear operational metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Security, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, compliance obligations, and customer impact.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and change procedures, and raise standards through reviews, templates, and shared practices.
* Coach and mentor engineers, helping teams adopt SRE ways of working and strengthening operational ownership.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Significant experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) supporting production services and making reliability improvements that stick.
* Demonstrated ownership of reliability practices such as SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident actions, and operational readiness.
* Strong AWS knowledge and hands-on experience operating cloud services (for example: EKS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and CloudWatch/CloudWatch Insights).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (for example, Terraform) and with CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitLab CI/CD).
* Experience with Kubernetes, including production operations on managed platforms such as Amazon EKS.
* Ability to script to automate and solve (for example, Python and/or JavaScript), with an engineering approach to testing, review, and maintainability.
* Experience building actionable monitoring and alerting that balances sensitivity and noise (for example, Datadog and CloudWatch).
* Confidence presenting, staying calm during incidents, and influencing teams through data, clear writing, and pragmatic recommendations.

**Good to have Skills:**
Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, networking, security, policy, and multi-tenant considerations).
  
  
Experience with performance testing, load testing, and capacity modelling for cloud-native services.
  
  
Software engineering experience in Python and/or JavaScript beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews).
  
  
Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric develop, alert tuning, incident analytics).
